question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Hands down
solution:
The correct answer is: **Easily and without doubt**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Hands down" **describes something that is easy and unquestionably true.

 
 
• Example - *The last time we played tennis he beat me **hands down**.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **"Hands down"** is "**Easily and without doubt**"
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
